title: Power Stack Watchlist
method: Action-oriented queue combining business quality, valuation, technical location and the active macro regime. Social/creator flow is hypothesis-only.
marketRegime: Higher US/Japan bond yields plus persistent Hormuz/product tightness are raising the cost of duration. Prefer cash-generative scarcity exposures, fertilizer/agriculture productivity, nuclear fuel, grid bottlenecks and selective software strength; avoid chasing stretched commodity or AI-beta moves.

buckets.label: Buy / Accumulate
buckets.description: Price and thesis are aligned enough for staged entry.

buckets.label: Selective / Retest
buckets.description: Good business or theme, but entry quality needs a better level or confirmation.

buckets.label: Wait / Confirm
buckets.description: Interesting exposure, but current risk/reward is not strong enough to force.

buckets.label: Avoid / High Risk
buckets.description: Theme may be attractive, but company, dilution or earnings risk currently dominates.

candidates.name: CF Industries
candidates.entry: $123–127 preferred; small starter only if ~$128–130 holds
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$118 or a sharp collapse in nitrogen margins / US gas advantage
candidates.thesis: Best current commodity-agriculture expression: nitrogen is difficult to defer, North American gas economics remain advantaged, and current cash flow/buybacks reduce reliance on multiple expansion. Demand destruction is real at the margin, so do not chase.

candidates.name: Corteva
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$78 or weakening seed pricing / separation economics
candidates.thesis: Highest-quality long-duration agriculture candidate. Farmers can trim some inputs, but they still must plant; genetics and yield resilience become more valuable as weather and input costs worsen.

candidates.name: Cameco
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$92 or deterioration in contracting / mine / Westinghouse evidence
candidates.thesis: Prefer fuel-cycle scarcity and operating assets over pre-revenue reactor hype. Long-term nuclear contracting and Westinghouse exposure provide multiple earnings channels.

candidates.name: Bunge Global
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$106 or Viterra integration / crush-margin deterioration
candidates.thesis: A diversified way to monetize crop-flow volatility rather than guessing which crop wins. End-food demand is resilient, while processing/trading margins and integration execution remain the key risks.

candidates.name: Cheniere Energy
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$268 or rapid normalization of global LNG scarcity/spreads
candidates.theme: LNG · energy security · Europe / Asia rerouting
candidates.thesis: US LNG infrastructure is a cleaner energy-security toll-road than chasing spot gas. Qatar/Hormuz disruption and European storage risk improve the setup, but the stock is close to momentum resistance.

candidates.name: Quanta Services
candidates.invalidation: Sustained break below ~$560 with backlog/order deterioration
candidates.thesis: The physical grid bottleneck remains one of the cleanest AI-capex expressions. Higher yields make valuation discipline more important, but they do not erase the transmission/substation backlog.

candidates.name: Eaton
candidates.thesis: Exceptional electrical order/backlog evidence, but bond yields are a real valuation headwind. Buy the bottleneck on support rather than paying any price for the story.

candidates.name: Nutrien
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$69 or clear fertilizer demand destruction / potash deterioration
candidates.thesis: Diversifies across potash, nitrogen and retail. More demand-deferrable than CF's nitrogen exposure, but a solid cash-generative hedge against prolonged fertilizer scarcity.

candidates.name: Valmont Industries
candidates.thesis: Useful crossover between utility infrastructure and a potential irrigation-cycle bottom. Agriculture capex is cyclical, so the grid segment provides ballast while El Niño/water stress creates recovery optionality.

candidates.name: Freeport-McMoRan
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$64 or structural copper-demand/supply thesis break
candidates.thesis: Copper remains structurally strong, but current pricing is distorted by tariff/inventory flows and the stock is too close to resistance to chase.

candidates.name: AGCO Corporation
candidates.entry: No aggressive entry until crop/farm margins improve
candidates.confirmation: Evidence of farm-income recovery + improving equipment orders
candidates.invalidation: Further equipment-demand cuts or persistent fertilizer/fuel squeeze
candidates.thesis: Potentially large 2027 upside if higher crop prices restore farm income after deferred equipment purchases. Food is a staple; machinery is not, so wait for the farm-economics turn.

candidates.name: NuScale Power
candidates.entry: No entry until commercial/financing evidence improves
candidates.thesis: Nuclear remains strong, but operating fuel/components remain preferable to venture-style reactor equities in a rising-yield regime.
